meals.note: Ludia not recruited yet? She stays until Support 3. Halvin needs 3 by the end of the Baina trip.
Halvin to Support 3 first, then Sha Lan (by 10/14) and Lysander (Ch 10 filler). Dadao is Inyoni's only partner.
Fillers for Ch 10 to 12. Anyone above still short keeps a seat first. Short of Support? Use the replay loop below.

gifts.note: Buy several on the Mahon trip
Buy several on the Orens trip
Buy several on the Breston trip

weekly.text: Short of Support? Replay this chapter for meals: hold them, Restart Chapter, save at the end
detail: Support is global, so the loop covers every recruit and filler. Source: RPG Site's support guide.

weekly.text: Ch 9 runs 7 weeks: dungeon parties with the new recruits on the link-attack side (MVP EXP)

missables.text: Do Great Dancer's Successor on this trip: its [[item:Dancer's Necklace]] makes Leda a Dancer
missables.lose: The Dancer's Necklace, so Leda's Dancer class

missables.text: Clear My Late Sister's Accessory if it shows up: it is what lets Creek join in Part II
missables.lose: The Part II join for Creek
detail: Semi-random: one guide sees it in Ch 9 on Leda's route, another can't pin it down.

missables.text: Meet Sirocco at Temple Row at 18:00, then follow him to Hightown for a second scene

note.text: Renown is 7 to 8 here: Advanced (Renown 8) opens at the very end of Ch 9 at best, so plan for Ch 10
detail: Renown 8 before 9/1? Take any unit already at Lv 35, in the ledger order.
Sirocco stays Shaman until Ovate opens in Ch 10.
Ludia, Inyoni and Halvin join near Lv 15: Specialty at Lv 20, late Ch 9 (Ch 10 if it slips).

override.text: Armored Knight in week 1 if she missed Lv 20 in Ch 8 (the Sealed Letter License)
Archer at Lv 20 (Bow C): Crescendo banks before her first map
Charioteer at Lv 20: Rider D (manual + Mounted) and Bow C

buy.text: Buy Advanced Licenses at [[place:Megaira]] on the Saveilon trip: as many of the 7 as stock allows
detail: So Ch 10's exams are ready. Dagsion sells them from Ch 10.
Need one less if Ogmios is open: [[place:Giant's-Print Fort]] (Lv 35) holds an Advanced License

buy.text: [[place:Port of Pandora]]: three [[item:Ji]] (3,000G) and four [[item:Short Spear]]s
detail: Ji: Catania, Jasmine, Sha Lan. Short Spears: Buccar, Esmeralda, Jasmine, Sha Lan.

buy.text: [[place:Orens]] (Perform run): 3 [[item:Da Mina Bow]]s: Inyoni's, plus 2 for Its Name Is Da Mina
detail: The spares go in at Temple Row in Ch 10 (any 2 Da Mina weapons).
[[place:Baina Oasis]]: 10 Dates for Halvin's recruit.

barter.for: Esmeralda (Buccar has the Dione Fort copy)
Dadao, after his first goes to Esmeralda
Sirocco, optional: only for this map (Io brings one on 9/28)

assign.why: Dadao's, in prep: Brawn makes it Wt 16
Rubess Forest copy, read the day he joins: Rider D for Charioteer
Nemea Cavern copy: Heavy D for Dreadnought

note.text: Blacksmith: Inyoni's [[item:Da Mina Bow +2]] (rare ore), Halvin's [[item:Wooden Bow +5]] on his join
detail: Rare ores short for the Da Mina? Inyoni takes a [[item:Wooden Bow]] to +5 (common ore) instead.
Halvin's Wooden Bow is the second Yaaman copy from Ch 4.

recruits.action: Pay 3,000G in week 1 (Renown 7): main archer, trains in Ch 9 and deploys from Ch 10
detail: She joins at about Lv 15 with a [[item:War Bow]] (one player test): Archer at Lv 20, Bow C from Infantry.
EXP: every Ch 9 dungeon party; she sits the Cai battle (its 8 slots are set).
Leda's Mini Bow and Archer's Ring go to her in Ch 10 prep.

recruits.action: Hand over the 10 Dates from Baina Oasis once Support 3 and Renown 7 land: bench archer
detail: He joins at about Lv 15: read the Riding Manual at once, then Arena Mounted for Rider D.
Charioteer at Lv 20 (late Ch 9) with Bow C; give him the Horsekiller Bow and his Wooden Bow +5.
EXP: dungeon parties with Inyoni and Ludia for the rest of Ch 9.

prep.text: Ludia not in yet (Renown 7 came late)? Recruit her in week 1: her row is in Ch 8
Lysander (Renown 7, filler) waits for Ch 10 week 1 with the other fillers

route.note: Do most of the six dances now: the main push toward Renown 8 for Ch 10
detail: 150 to 200 Renown, crates and 5,000G each. All six are due 11/27.

route.note: Do Captain's and Popular Drink Recipes on this trip
The Search node is past Port of Pandora: do it on that dance trip
detail: Song of Icewater goes to +7 for Ch 10 to 12.
Song of Passion goes to +7 for Ch 10 to 12.

sub.note: Leda only, starts on its own: do it on this desert trip; buy the 20 Dates in Baina
Finish it by 9/1: the listed 9/16 falls in the gap before Ch 10
Violet Brooch from [[place:Axion Gorge]]: Creek's Part II join

explore.text: Plan the whole loop to [[place:Baina Oasis]] first: red paths vanish behind you
detail: You move 1 to 2 nodes per turn. Reaching Baina once opens a permanent green shortcut.
Finish the quests that end 10/15 on the same trip: the path guide routes them through the desert.
Skipped Dragonbone Tangle in Ch 7? Clear it now: Sha Lan's Hexlock Shield.

explore.text: On the Megaira trip, pick up the [[place:Lake Brontes]] statue for Legacy of a Legendary Sculptor
Bench EXP: Cave Behind the Falls, Cougar Woodlands, Sand-Shadow Fort with Inyoni, Ludia, Halvin
detail: Fifth seat: Guzran or Esmeralda as the carry; feed the Lv 15 joins the kills.
Link attacks raise their Supports too. Lv 28+ dungeons wait until they reach Lv 20.
Jasmine and Fianna rotate in once a joiner hits Lv 20.

explore.text: Mine rare ores on every run: Cullet (Aditi's Cave), Windstone (Cougar Woodlands, Stoppered Shrine)
detail: Blue Snoll: [[place:Iapetus Cavern]]. They pay Inyoni's Da Mina Bow +2 and any special still short of +2.

explore.text: [[place:Aditi's Cave]] (Lv 28, Nysiades): Archive L for Sirocco, read it at once
detail: Kill 3 Sandworms here for Nezha's Sandworm Meat (Ch 10 to 11 filler). Lv 20+ party only.

explore.text: [[place:Iapetus Cavern]] (Lv 32, Solidus): Archive θ for Sirocco, read it at once
detail: Also a Black-Magic Manual. Can't clear it yet? Do it in Ch 11.

explore.text: [[place:Nemea Cavern]] (Lv 30, Pasithea): a second [[item:Hammer]] for Dadao, Heavy-Armor Manual
detail: The manual is Jasmine's: read it at once (Heavy D). Also an [[item:Elixir]].

explore.text: [[place:Cave Behind the Falls]] (Lv 22, Castalia): [[item:Pure Water]]; skip its Archive B
detail: Mire Β (Mt 3) has no job here: read it on anyone or leave it.
Muen is cursed (Curse 2): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Part III: Eshmel's gauge brake (his build page).

explore.text: Sand-Shadow Fort (Lv 23, Nysiades): [[item:Gundogya]], a cursed axe, Large Bullion
detail: A Giant always spawns there, for Giant's Meat.
Gundogya is cursed (Curse 1): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).

explore.text: Run [[place:Stoppered Shrine]] (Lv 25, Idyia) with the meal pairs: [[item:Velheit]], Flower Painting
detail: Velheit is cursed (Curse 1): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Part III: Orchel's axe (Automaton: Curse never moves her gauge).

explore.text: Skip Southern Passage, Northern Passage, Enno Isle and Uncharted Isle: closed to Leda in Part I

tips.text: Buccar defects to you on Turn 1 and stays after the battle
Maria summons enemies on Turn 3. The explosives hit hard: use them
Armor: Esmeralda's [[item:Hammer]], then a Dance into the next knight; Guzran's [[item:Flyssa]]
Sirocco takes the [[item:Levin Sword]] only if you bartered it and he has Sword C
